R1_DEPENDENCY_SCOPED_EFFECT_ENVELOPE.result: Across 16 exhaustive one-shot schedules and 100000 fuzz cases / 350618 recurrent commit attempts, stale permit reuse was unsafe; a whole-state epoch guard eliminated unsafe commits but produced false aborts from unrelated churn; an exact decision read-set + current capability epoch/validity envelope produced zero unsafe commits and zero false aborts in the constructed model.
R1_DEPENDENCY_SCOPED_EFFECT_ENVELOPE.revision_to_parent: Refine generic snapshot/transaction guidance: for effect commit, prefer the smallest dependency-complete read-set/invariant envelope plus capability freshness, not automatically one global state epoch. Whole-ledger CAS remains a valid simpler countercandidate if target Ubuntu H1 cost is acceptable.
R1_DEPENDENCY_SCOPED_EFFECT_ENVELOPE.counterhypothesis: Single-threaded H1 or whole-ledger CAS may be cheap and simpler enough to dominate dependency-scoped validation in the real target runtime.
R1_DEPENDENCY_SCOPED_EFFECT_ENVELOPE.next_test: Frozen Ubuntu H1 effect-bearing replay comparing whole-ledger CAS vs per-domain/object dependency envelopes under unrelated churn, revoke/regrant, queue delay, crash/restart and child-code effects.

R2_CLAYCODE_LEXICAL_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.result: Current G9 lexical surface is not closed under its admitted uses: REF matching overconsumed structural delimiter + following ref in 10000/10000 generated adjacent-ref cases; unspaced subtraction collided with hyphenated bare identifiers in 10000/10000 cases. A delimiter-aware REF candidate fixed the tested REF family, while simply removing hyphens fixes subtraction but breaks 10000/10000 admitted hyphenated-name cases.
R2_CLAYCODE_LEXICAL_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.blocker: BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE frontend closure must be resolved before parser/canonical semantic identity can be trusted for the affected source families.
R2_CLAYCODE_LEXICAL_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.constraint: Do not solve by broad semantic redesign. Preserve compatibility through an explicit escaped/sigil/quoted symbol route or another tested lexical design, then run roundtrip/canonical-hash regression.

R3_CTK_COMPILER_INTERNAL_CONVERGENCE.result: Current evidence increasingly supports compiling the existing G9 surface into a canonical typed Causal Transition Kernel for evaluator/verifier/lowering/instrumentation instead of creating another surface-language generation. The strongest next artifact is a BASE cross-branch semantic conformance suite through parse -> canonicalize -> semantic hash -> typed IR -> type/effect/flow check -> evaluator -> lowering -> runtime receipt -> replay.
R3_CTK_COMPILER_INTERNAL_CONVERGENCE.counterhypothesis: A unified CTK may become a giant tagged IR whose complexity exceeds a smaller family of typed IR layers.

clayresearch.delta: Adopt dependency-complete effect envelopes as the leading candidate over blanket global epochs, while retaining whole-ledger CAS as a target-cost countercandidate; use CTK only as compiler-internal hypothesis until conformance evidence.

frank.delta: Consequential recurrence should revalidate only its complete causal decision dependencies plus capability freshness; unrelated state churn should not force abort unless part of the invariant. No architecture claim advances until target replay.

gwt.delta: No GWT claim-state promotion. Future effect-bearing GWT routes must expose the exact decision dependency/read-set identity used at commit.

emergenz.delta: No emergence promotion. Dependency-scoped commit improves intervention hygiene but does not itself evidence emergence.

claycode.delta: Frontend lexical closure is now a concrete BASE blocker. Fix REF delimiters and identifier-minus ambiguity compatibly; then make the cross-branch conformance suite the primary integration test. No new FRANK/DB-specific core syntax is justified.

hyperposition.delta: No claim-state change; alternative routes participating in an effect must make dependency/read-set membership explicit.

claygraph.delta: Represent exact effect dependency envelope/read-set and capability epoch in dynamic trace topology; unrelated graph churn should not invalidate an effect unless dependency closure says it should.

unifieddb.delta: Support dependency-scoped snapshot/read-set validation in addition to coarse global epochs; benchmark both. Preserve semantic-vs-execution identity separation.

harness.delta: Add whole-ledger-CAS vs dependency-envelope differential to H1 replay. Also add ClayCode lexer/roundtrip fixtures so H2 cannot falsely pass on ambiguous source identity.

global_controls: no canonical promotion from synthetic/local proxy evidence
BASE blocker does not imply a surface-language redesign
